attribution.note: Marcus's own post. The Musk quote is only the prediction he rejects. The rejection, the title and the bet offer are Marcus's own words.

semantics.note: The title says firmly 'we won't see' human-superior AGI by end of 2025, and Marcus backs it with a bet. That is unhedged, so it counts as a scored forecast. The threshold and horizon match Musk's claim he is rejecting.

contract.note: The plain reading (general ability, not narrow benchmarks; deadline 31 Dec 2025) is ordinary and fair. Allowing a little slack past the deadline would not change the result.

evidence.note: Report by the ARC Prize organisers, available before the evaluation date. It judges AGI not yet achieved as of the end of the 2025 cycle.
Untrained humans solved every ARC-AGI-2 task, while the best 2025 competition entry scored 24%. So AI did not beat every human on general reasoning.

At Davos in January 2026, Musk said AI smarter than any human 'might' come later. That implies it had not arrived by the end of 2025. This is a report of a third party's statement, not Marcus's own words.
IMO gold in 2025 is a strong result in one narrow area. It does not show AI beat every human in general ability.

reviews.rationale: The deadline (end of 2025) has passed. The ARC Prize organisers judged AGI not achieved, and humans still solved tasks that AI failed. Musk himself put AI smarter than any human in the future as of January 2026. The narrow IMO result does not meet the contradiction condition. The forecast held.
